T0243.title: Virtual Gift Cashout Channel
T0243.definition: An underground live-streaming channel that buys users' virtual gifts at a discount and resells, cashes out, or launders them.
T0243.description:
A virtual gift cashout channel, sometimes advertised with code names such as “cake shop” or “supermarket,” buys virtual gifts from live-streaming users at discounted cash prices. Operators contact users who won or hold high-value gifts, then resell the gifts to clients who need ranking boosts, fake activity, or fund movement.

These channels exploit the difficulty of directly withdrawing virtual items, the complexity of gift-transfer flows, and the opacity of off-platform deals. They disrupt platform virtual economies and may support money laundering, fake transactions, and streamer-ranking manipulation.
T0243.usageExample: I won a castle gift yesterday, and right after I posted it for sale, someone from a supermarket messaged me asking if I wanted to sell.
